judgment.notes: The stage formulas, Sobolev norms, X norm, residual increments and grid identify all objects actually used. The comparison solution is used only through its smooth sample w=v(t_n); no PDE or mean-zero property of v is required. The export retains its original comparison conditions, constants and every partial endpoint. Derivatives are stepwise and a.e. globally, consistently with the piecewise regularity.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
